slides.headline: Compress AI coding output
slides.say: Stop scrolling... you can compress terminal output for AI coding assistants.

slides.headline: What it does
slides.say: This tool compresses terminal output that AI coding assistants read — test results, git diffs, install logs — so more context fits in the conversation. It runs locally with no extra AI calls.

slides.headline: 166 GitHub stars
slides.body: Apache-2.0 licence · Written in Python · Since February 2026
slides.say: It has over 0 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the Apache-2.0 licence.

slides.headline: Before you use it
slides.say: Not every command compresses — some output is already dense or needed verbatim. The tool returns original text rather than risk losing important details. Read the README and licence first.
